story.title: Our Story | A Pakistani Footwear Brand for Men
story.description: Why DAUR Supply exists: men's leather shoes and sneakers from workshops in Lahore, Sialkot and Kasur, checked by hand and dispatched from Islamabad.

promise.title: Our Promise: Delivery, Exchanges and Defect Cover
promise.description: What every DAUR order includes: free delivery across Pakistan, a 5 day size exchange, 30 day defect cover and a pair checked by hand before dispatch.

about.title: About DAUR Supply | Men's Shoes Online in Pakistan
about.description: DAUR Supply is an online men's footwear brand in Pakistan: leather sneakers, formal shoes, chelsea boots and loafers, dispatched from Islamabad.

shipping.title: Shipping and Delivery Across Pakistan
shipping.description: How DAUR Supply delivers: free delivery to every city our couriers reach, 2 to 5 days, dispatch from Islamabad, the Care deposit and paying the rest on delivery.

returns.title: Returns and Refunds Policy
returns.description: When a DAUR Supply pair can be returned, the condition it must be in, who pays the return courier and how refunds are made.

exchange.title: Size Exchange Policy: 5 Days
exchange.description: Exchange a DAUR Supply pair for another size within 5 days of delivery: unworn, in the original box. Sale pairs are final for size.

claims.title: Defect Claims: 30 Day Cover
claims.description: How to claim for a manufacturing defect on a DAUR Supply pair within 30 days: what is covered, the photos we need and what happens next.

cancellation.title: Order Cancellation Policy
cancellation.description: How to cancel a DAUR Supply order before dispatch, what happens after dispatch and how a Care deposit is handled when an order is cancelled.

size-guide.title: Men's Shoe Size Chart Pakistan: EU, UK, US
size-guide.description: DAUR men's shoe size chart with EU, UK and US sizes and foot length in cm and inches, plus how to measure your foot at home.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers on sizing, delivery times, the Care deposit, payment on delivery, exchanges, defect claims and tracking your DAUR Supply order.

track.title: Track Your Order
track.description: Follow your DAUR Supply order from confirmation to delivery with the link in your order email or by signing in to your account.

contact.title: Contact DAUR Supply | WhatsApp, Phone and Email
contact.description: Contact DAUR Supply on WhatsApp or phone at 0319 9628735 or by email at contact@daursupply.com for sizing, orders and exchanges.

giving.title: Our Giving: At Least 5% of Profit
giving.description: DAUR Supply sets aside at least 5% of its profit, never added to your price, and gives it each quarter. See the causes and the record.

offers.title: Offers and Sale Pairs
offers.description: Current DAUR Supply offers and men's shoes on sale in Pakistan, with the original price shown beside every reduced pair.

feed.title: The Feed: DAUR Pairs Up Close
feed.description: DAUR Supply men's sneakers, leather shoes and chelsea boots up close, with prices and colours. Save the pairs you like and share them.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How DAUR Supply collects, uses and protects the personal information you share when you browse the store and place an order.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that apply when you use the DAUR Supply store and buy from us, including orders, prices, payment and delivery.
